title: Where a local housing strategy or local planning instrument sets dwelling mix: mix provided in accordance with it
text: (a) Dwelling mix is provided in accordance with the objectives, proportions or targets specified in a local housing strategy or relevant local planning instrument OR
notes: Alternative to A4.8.1(b); the two are made exclusive by site.local_housing_mix_requirement. verify: (b) applies only where there is 'no local housing strategy', while (a) also names any 'relevant local planning instrument'; a site with an LPI mix target but no strategy is read under (a). Where the strategy states objectives rather than numbers, compliance is a judgment the applicant can only assert.

verified.note: Limbs (a) OR (b) confirmed. (a) names "a local housing strategy or relevant local planning instrument" while (b) applies only "where there is no local housing strategy": a site with an LPI mix target but no strategy falls under both; read under (a).
